notes.title: Watch the developer, Alex play a run of Star Deck!
notes.notes:
Hi, my name is Alex and I'm the solo developer working on this game. I hope you'll join me for this pre-recorded walkthrough of a single run of the demo, to give you an idea about the game mechanics for how the different weapons work, and core game mechanics.

At it's core, [b]Star Deck is a deckbuilding roguelike experience[/b], so many players will feel comfortable if they have experience with similar games like Slay the Spire. 

[b]The difference in Star Deck is a dual wielding weapon experience where the deck you build becomes a mix of the weapons you choose on each run.[/b] The demo has 2 weapons available, the laser blaster & ice hammer. Final game will have 5 unlockable weapons, and the fun will be experimenting with different combinations as you play more difficult New Games!

Final game will have 5-6 levels to play through on each run. The robot city, aptly named Robotica is just the first level that I've made for the demo.

[b]I'll be running a Kickstarter next month, on March 5th this year, so please follow it here if you'd like to see this game come to fruition:[/b] https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/572883522/star-deck


I won't be able to finish the game without funding, as there is still a lot of work yet to do. With your help I plan to release the finished product in Q2 of 2025. Thanks so much for your support, and I hope you enjoy the demo... game on!

Hey everyone! As we gear up for Steam Next Fest on Feb 5th - 12th, we've released the newest, best version of the demo to really make a splash! 

If you haven't already, [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/572883522/star-deck]please follow the Kickstarter here[/url].

We added some new cards to the Blaster deck to give it a bit more [i]OOMPH[/i] since the hammer was getting a bit too much love.

Stay tuned in the next 2 weeks for our live stream announcement schedules during the event.

[list]
[*]Added battle VFX
[*]Added in Chromatic Aberration & Vignette to Post FX for damage triggers
[*]Cool new EDM soundtrack!
[*]Fix persistent bug on boss music transition
[*]Fix bug with hand being dealt after battle has been won

[*]Updated the Main Menu BG & Title
[*]Finally fully completely actually fixed so music doesn't play same track between battles
[*]Replaced HUD block icon to be UI Image so it doesn't have character shadow on it
[*]Changed damage animation & font
[*]Changed Next Action font
[*]Increased screen shake on damage triggers
[*]Added shadow for Amor Bot
[*]Fix description on Clip Extender item for readability
[*]Added cast animations for ArmorBot & DroneBot
[*]Added SFX for Blind & Taunt
[*]Improve hand deal time at battle start
[*]Add coin SFX to ATM event
[*]Boss health bar stays after battle wins for consistency
[*]Fix demo completion screen
[*]Fix font issue with End Turn button in battles
[*]Fix DroneBot stun animation position
[*]Fix Heal font & animation
[*]Fix Rob Attack Buff noise
[*]Clean up card text alignment, add Italicized text for the flavortext, shrink weapon icons on cards
[*]Add Powers status icon in the character HUD, and in status hover description

Card changes:

[list]
[*]Refactor Final Blow code for code cleanup (much cleaner now)

As always, [b]THANKS FOR YOUR SUPPORT! WE CAN'T WAIT FOR NEXT FEST LET'S GOOOOOOO!!!![/b]
